text: player
To the Final Showdown
Leafa
Hyaaah!
Monsters
ROAR...!
Sinon
Target silenced... How many is that now?
Urghhh, come on...! There's just no end to these monsters!
Yui Yagi
...Senpai, something's not right.
Ichihime
I can sense something fishy too, nyaa! I think we might just be going in circles?!
Kirito
Yui, can you help us run a scan of this area? We seem to be trapped here.
Yui
Okay, Papa! Analyzing now...
Asuna
What is it, Yui?
Analysis complete. Papa, you were right... something's off about this area!
The energy and data are completely tangled up here... This area is an artificially-created loop – there's no way to reach the end...!
A Möbius strip...
Natsuki Shinomiya
So, that's the reason for this endless stream of monsters? I'll run out of stamina before even facing the final boss... Hehe... Now it's really getting exciting!
...How about we focus on finding a way out of this mess first?!
How do we escape from this...?
First, let's calm down and assess the situation. We need to go over the information we actually have.
We might be going in circles through the same area, but some details change ever so slightly each time.
Anything made of data is likely to have flaws. So, any "anomalies" in otherwise identical scenes should be our ticket out of here.
Right! Now that you mention it...
...Was there a moon ornament like that hanging over the entrance to Mahjong Soul Shrine before?
I don't remember anything like that at all, nyaa! That bad rabbit has awful taste, nyaa...!
That's it...! Sinon, can you take that out for us?
...Got it!
(BANG!)
D-did it work?!
...I can see a path, but now even more monsters are coming out!
Heh... I'm afraid this is where fate parts us!
Natsuki?
I'll stay here and halt their advance! You, the knight called Kirito, storm the boss's chamber and put an end to all this!
Huh? But with so many enemies...
Wanjirou
Listen to our chunibyo friend. If we keep dilly-dallying here, we can kiss ramen for dinner goodbye, woof.
We'll cover the rear.
Then I'll help out, too! Dealing with this many enemies calls for my wind magic!
Yeah... I'm staying behind, too. Kirito, Asuna, I know you guys can do it.
We can do this!
We won't let you down!
Kaguyahime
Tch, what a bunch of brutes! How dare they wreck my meticulously designed maze!
Kaguyahime! We found you at last! Turn Mahjong Soul Shrine back to the way it was, now!
Ohoho... You're in my domain now, so I suggest you follow MY rules.
In this realm where the rules of mahjong reign supreme, we shall settle the score at the table.
I'll graciously allow you all to challenge me at once. If even a single one of you manages to score higher than me, I will end this immediately.
And if you lose... ohoho...
If we lose, what...?
I'll feed you to my monsters, of course! Then you'll be just one more stepping stone on my way to conquer this world!
That's taking it too far...!
If we try to escape, things in this world will only get worse...
Don't worry, Asuna. There's only one thing we have to do.
You're right. And we're all in this fight together!
Me too... We can't afford to lose, so we'll just have to win!
Oh? Have you made up your minds then?
...That's right, Kaguyahime! We accept your challenge!
Your courage is commendable. Alright then, let the game begin!
Everyone, you got this, nyaa!
{var:player_nickname}, you know this world pretty well, right? Have you noticed anything that seems off to you?
...Got it! Stay safe, everyone!//nAsuna, Ichihime, {var:player_nickname}, let's get going!
